onboarding.title: Indlela i-OpenDoor esebenza ngayo
onboarding.body: Ukungena okukodwa. Ingxoxo kusiphequluli, indlu yozakwethu be-OpenBot, nechibi lemali elihlanganyelwe. Khetha isifunda — asivimbi izwe.
onboarding.pickRegionHint: Lokhu kushintsha umbhalo nezilungiselelo kuphela. Zonke izifunda zingabhalisa.
onboarding.productChatBody: Vula Ingxoxo ukhulume namamodeli kufoni noma ikhompyutha. Awudingi ukhiye we-API ukuze uqale.
onboarding.productHouseBody: I-OpenBot iyindlu yozakwethu — umholi kanye nochwepheshe obangezayo. Babelana ngendawo eyodwa.
onboarding.productPoolBody: Umndeni nethimba babelana ngechibi elilodwa. I-akhawunti eyodwa, hhayi ukhiye ngomuntu ngamunye.

africa.school: Isikole: amakhasi alula kufoni, isihlalo soMfundi seklasi noma umsebenzi wasekhaya, ngaphandle kwedatha eyengeziwe ukufinyelela imodeli.
africa.family: Umndeni: ichibi elilodwa lendlu. Abazali nezingane basebenzisa imali efanayo — kushibhe kunezikweletu ezine, kwakhelwe izindleko zedatha.
africa.team: Ithimba: indawo eyodwa yelebhu, i-NGO, noma isitolo. Mema nge-imeyili. Bonke babelana ngechibi.

europe.school: Isikole: ukuqala koMfundi kweklasi noma ilebhu, umgwaqo ofanayo no-Pro.
europe.family: Umndeni: ichibi lendlu elinokudlulisela — ubulungu obubodwa kwendlu.
europe.team: Ithimba: i-SSO nezilawuli ezihlanganyelwe. I-Enterprise ikhuluma nokuthengisa.

americas.school: Isikole: uMfundi ubulungu bomsebenzi wasekhaya namalebhu. Amamodeli afanayo no-Pro.
americas.family: Umndeni: ichibi lendlu, kushibhe kunezihlalo ezine ze-Pro.
americas.team: Ithimba: izihlalo ozizenzela. I-Enterprise: ukuhlala kwedatha, i-SCIM, nokuthengisa.

asia_pacific.school: Isikole: qala kufoni. uMfundi uhlanganisa isihlalo; amathokheni ahlala entengo yenkundla.
asia_pacific.family: Umndeni: ichibi elilodwa lendlu ukuze ungathengi idatha nezihlalo kane.
asia_pacific.team: Ithimba: indawo eyodwa, mema ozakwenu, yabelana ngemali.

middle_east.school: Isikole: uhlelo loMfundi lweklasi nocwaningo. Isi-Arabhu ulimi oluqala.
middle_east.family: Umndeni: ichibi lendlu — i-akhawunti eyodwa kwendlu.
middle_east.team: Ithimba: indawo ehlanganyelwe ne-SSO uma udinga. I-Enterprise ngokuthengisa.

getStarted.title: Khetha indlela yakho.
getStarted.body: I-OpenDoor ilungela isikole, umndeni, nethimba. Khetha isifunda — akekho ovinjwa nge-geo.
getStarted.startFreeBody: Zenzele umuntu oyedwa noma ithimba elincane. Qhubeka nge-imeyili.
getStarted.educationBody: Ezikoleni, emalebhu, nakubafundi. Ukuqala kuhlala kufana nesikole.
getStarted.enterpriseBody: Izinhlangano ezikhona zingena nge-SSO. Ukusetshenziswa okusha kuqala ngokuthengisa.

gettingStarted.title: Siyakwamukela ku-OpenDoor
gettingStarted.coreDone: Ukusetha okuyinhloko kuphelile. Izinyathelo ezikhethwa zikhona uma uzidinga.
gettingStarted.coreTodo: Ingxoxo nozakwethu oyedwa kukufaka emkhiqizweni. Okunye akuphoqelekile.

tools.searchOneLiner: Buza umbuzo. I-OpenDoor Search iphendula ngemithombo ku-stack yethu — ikhokhwa emalini yakho, ayikho izinkinobho zokusesha zangaphandle.

openbot.houseBody: Indlu yindawo yakho ye-OpenBot: uzakwethu omholi kanye nochwepheshe obangezayo. Babelana ngeziteshi, amakhono, nechibi lemali lenhlangano. Qala isiteshi ukuze ukhulume; engeza uzakwethu uma ufuna indima enegama.

settings.languageRegionHint: Isetshenziswa ekungeneni, ekuqaleni, nasesikrinini sokuqala. Enye ideshibhodi ihlala ngesiNgisi okwamanje.
